profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Iron Galaxy Studios
profile.summary:
Highly skilled senior software development engineer and manager with many years of proven experience leading software and hardware development, design, integration projects, and teams with a focus on technological innovation.  A strategic leader known for fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Adept at recruiting and leading teams responsible for building cutting-edge software which integrates with custom designed hardware and visualizing in 3D and virtual reality based interactive software solutions.

See: www.ericalbers.com for portfolio/examples
Video games, Who Framed Roger Rabbit video game for Disney after leaving University of Delaware, then on to be 3rd employee of Maxis and SimCity/Sims wrote/designed SimFarm in that series of games (Codie award).
Founded Leaping Lizard software...lots of video games written/developed, Created slot machine for Bally Gaming,the "Game Magic" machine. Monopoly Casino for Hasbro, slots, table games, roulette and craps.
I can manage teams, but I enjoy balancing between managing with being in the trenches with the team,
I'm used to working 'On Time, On Budget, or else'...
Love mixing technologies, robotics, embedded controllers, emerging hardware with software, creating softwaretoys. 
Experience with LIDAR, creating scans in realtime, displaying in 3d.

Firehose: Tensorflow/Keras Neural Networks, GPT3 Api work, Hololens, Hololens2, AR/VR development with
Oculus,mixed reality and Vive, 3D using Unity engine, Embedded controllers, C++/C#/.Net,Visual Studio/Assembly,
Java/Javascript/Ajax/NodeJS, Android development, Eagle PCB design, web design in Angular,ReactJS, raw javascript.
Hardware design and development, pic microcontrollers to full scale large production software deployments.

Jenkins, PHP, WebGL MySQL LAMP/MERN/MEAN full-stack development experience creating online projects for multi-login environments, using Docker containers on AWS/EC2 instances, (and not as case may be) Android App development

Robotics: Have started/Mentored several FIRST robotics teams at elementary and high school level, getting Kids into STEM through robots, showing them the fun in curiosity... see my current high school team http://loellenrobotics.ca/loellenrobotics/ great kids, an honour to serve them.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on several projects bringing my skills in Hardware design, AI and games together to create compelling player experiences.  Training reinforcement learning and imitation learning AI models to solve problems.  Using convolutional neural networks to do gesture recognition from simple camera inputs to solve complex game related problems.

positions.title: Vice President Software Development/Software Architecture
positions.description:
Developed and executed engineering strategy, vision, and roadmap aligned with company’s goals and objectives across multiple innovative baseball products used by MLB and college teams.

Use AI tools to generate custom AI models to identify ball flight information and location.  Developed ML network in Tensorflow/Keras to predict pitch types from physics metadata gathered by yakkertech sensors.
Collaborated with and contributed to building an innovative, high-performing engineering team comprised of software engineers, hardware engineers, and quality assurance professionals to setup AWS EC2 instances and RDS/NOSQL database services with live global data feeds.
 
Architected frontend and backend Linux systems using ReactJS and Angular while incorporating Node.JS, C#, Python and PM2.

Drove technical excellence across engineering teams, defining, and ensuring application of best practices, coding standards, and structured quality assurance processes.

Fostered a solution-focused culture that leverages a customer-centric and business value approach to product development and enhancements.

Collaborated with key stakeholders, including executives, customers, vendors, and product managers to understand and define requirements and align engineering approach.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect & Engineer
positions.description:
Led development from the ground up of PitchR, a cutting-edge 3D baseball data visualization platform that leverages ball tracking, motion capture, and sensor data with real-time replay and analysis features for multiple commercial applications.

Leveraged strong technical background in both software and hardware development to investigate and apply the latest advancements in relevant technology, including 3D, virtual reality, data visualization, and rendering, to improve products, advance market differentiation, and drive success.

Supported development of the Ballr product with the creation of data filtering algorithms to allow for the efficient and effective interpretation and comparison of pitch data including ball spin, axis, and seam orientation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed virtual meeting software that allows clients to visualize large environments with models rendered in real-time using Hololens/Vive and LIDAR. 

CNN Neural Network coding using Tensorflow/Keras to solve FFT discrimination problems.

Designed embedded controller and integrated software that leveraged gyroscopes and real-time data reporting for mapping of drill hole locations and shapes in underground mining applications.

positions.title: Director of Product Development
positions.description: In partnership with SNOLab, a Canadian underground science laboratory specializing in neutrino and dark matter physics, worked collaboratively with team on defining requirements, design, architecture, development, and implementation of software solutions using advanced AI technology (genetic algorithms and recurrent neural networks) developed to improve scheduling options across industries. Results rendered in Unity engine and WebGL using LAMP stack.

patents.title: Three Dimensional Representation of sports data from multiple sources
patents.description: A three dimensional representation of sports data from multiple sources, which has A) a computer program stored on a non-transitory computer readable medium, B) a server operatively associated with the non-transitory computer readable medium, C) a computer vision model using feature detection algorithms, D) a database associated to the computer vision model, E) data to upload to the database, F) a graphical user interface to show data, and G) a computer device, whereby users access to the graphical user interface to upload and visualize the data. The data is visually shown through two-dimension and three-dimension images, text, numbers, animations, and custom visuals to allow the users to analyze the data.
